The issuer shows solid liquidity with a current ratio of 2.29 and healthy capital via positive retained earnings and substantial shareholders’ equity. Leverage is moderate (total liabilities of 27,401M against total assets of 58,167M) and operating profitability appears reasonable (EBIT of 811M on revenue of 5,633M, ~14% margin). Overall, these fundamentals align most closely with the lower end of investment grade.

DECISION: BBB+
